articles.title: North Korea Fires Suspected Missile as Diplomacy Efforts Stall
articles.summary: North Korea is believed to have launched a missile on Thursday, just one day after the United States announced it would scale back joint military exercises with South Korea. The US had hoped the move would encourage North Korea to return to peace talks. However, North Korea dismissed the gesture, and the suspected launch raised fresh concerns about security on the Korean Peninsula. Experts say tensions in the region remain high, with neighbouring countries and the international community closely watching North Korea's actions. The situation highlights how difficult it can be to use diplomacy to resolve disagreements between countries.

lv1: What did North Korea reportedly do on Thursday? (北韓據報在星期四做了什麼？)
Why did the United States decide to reduce its military exercises with South Korea? (美國為何決定縮減與南韓的聯合軍事演習？)
lv2: Why might North Korea have chosen to launch a missile right after the US made a goodwill gesture? (為何北韓可能選擇在美國作出善意姿態後發射導彈？)
How do actions like missile launches affect relationships between countries in the Asia-Pacific region? (導彈發射等行動如何影響亞太地區國家之間的關係？)
lv3: Should countries offer concessions like reducing military drills to encourage dialogue with nations like North Korea? What are the risks and benefits of this approach? (國家是否應透過讓步如縮減軍演來鼓勵與北韓等國對話？這種做法有何風險和好處？)

Some argue that international pressure and sanctions are the best way to change North Korea's behaviour, while others believe direct talks are more effective. Which approach do you think works better, and why? (有人認為國際制裁是改變北韓行為的最佳方法，也有人認為直接對話更有效。你認為哪種方法更好？為什麼？)

articles.title: Europe's Summer of Record Heat: Five Heat Waves in One Season
articles.summary: Europe has experienced five separate heat waves this summer, shattering temperature records across the continent. Alongside the extreme heat, large parts of the region have also suffered from drought and serious wildfires. Scientists say this pattern of extreme weather is directly connected to human-caused climate change, which is making summers hotter and more dangerous year by year. The situation has also become a major political topic, with different parties debating the best way to respond. Climate experts warn that without significant action to cut greenhouse gas emissions, heat waves like these will become even more common in the years ahead.

lv1: How many heat waves did Europe experience this summer? (歐洲今年夏天經歷了多少次熱浪？)
Besides extreme heat, what other environmental problems did Europe face this summer? (除了極端高溫，歐洲今年夏天還面對哪些環境問題？)
lv2: Why do scientists link Europe's record-breaking heat waves to climate change? (為何科學家將歐洲破紀錄的熱浪與氣候變化聯繫起來？)
How might repeated heat waves affect the daily lives of people living in Europe? (一再出現的熱浪會如何影響歐洲人的日常生活？)
lv3: Some governments focus on adapting to extreme heat (e.g. building cooling centres) rather than reducing carbon emissions. Is adaptation enough, or must we also tackle the root cause? Discuss. (部分政府著重適應極端高溫（例如建設降溫中心），而非減少碳排放。適應是否足夠，還是我們必須同時解決根本原因？試加以討論。)

Climate change affects countries very differently — poorer nations often suffer the most despite contributing least to the problem. Is this fair? What responsibilities do wealthy, high-emitting countries have? (氣候變化對不同國家影響懸殊——貧窮國家往往受害最深，卻排放最少。這公平嗎？高排放的富裕國家有什麼責任？)

articles.title: 天文台預警：低壓區逼近廣東沿岸 周末或需發一號戒備信號
articles.summary: 香港天文台於8月20日傍晚發出消息，指一個低壓區有可能在本周末靠近廣東沿岸地區，天文台正密切監測其動向，並評估是否需要發出一號戒備信號。天文台提醒市民留意天氣變化，出門前查閱最新預報。香港於夏季常受熱帶氣旋影響，市民應提前做好準備，包括固定家中容易被風吹走的物品，並避免前往郊外或海邊，以策安全。

lv1: 天文台警告市民留意哪種天氣現象？
一號戒備信號代表什麼意思？
lv2: 為什麼天文台需要提早通知市民有關低壓區的消息？
市民在熱帶氣旋警報發出前可以做哪些準備工作？
lv3: 隨著氣候變化加劇，香港未來面對的極端天氣可能更頻繁。政府、學校和市民各自應承擔什麼責任來應對這個挑戰？
有人認為香港的防風設施和預警系統已十分完善，但也有人認為仍有不足。你認為香港在應對熱帶氣旋方面還有哪些地方可以改善？

articles.title: 台灣動漫含大量吸煙畫面惹爭議 當局促平台審查內容保護青少年
articles.summary: 一套由日本漫畫改編、於今年7月在台灣串流平台首播的動漫《尼古喵喵》，因內容包含大量吸煙畫面而引發社會關注。有意見認為此類內容對青少年有不良影響，促請當局要求平台加強審查。台灣相關部門已介入調查，研究是否需要為動漫內容訂立更嚴格的分級制度。事件令外界再次關注網上串流平台的內容監管問題，以及家長和平台各自應承擔的責任。

lv1: 《尼古喵喵》這套動漫因為什麼內容而引起爭議？
這套動漫在哪個平台播出？
lv2: 為什麼動漫或電視節目中的吸煙畫面可能對青少年造成影響？
你認為串流平台應如何確保其內容適合不同年齡層的觀眾？
lv3: 有人認為創作自由不應受到限制，也有人認為保護青少年免受有害內容影響更重要。你認為兩者之間應如何取得平衡？
若要有效監管網上影片及動漫內容，政府、平台、家長和觀眾各自應扮演什麼角色？請從多角度分析。
